note: The weights here mirror supporter_points and my_points() in supabase/schema.sql. If one changes, all three change, or a supporter reads one thing and sees another.
season: Everything resets on 1 July, so a board is always winnable by somebody who joined in January.

groups.title: Telling other supporters something they could not find out
groups.why: The most work, and the only things on this list that are still useful to somebody three years from now.

items.what: Offering something to the archive project
A ground, access, parking or price report

groups.title: Getting other people to games
groups.why: Organising is worth more than turning up, because it is harder and somebody else benefits.

items.what: Adding a pub other fans can find
Offering or asking for a lift
Rating the players after a game
Starting a topic on the wall
Voting in a poll, or backing a pub

groups.title: On the wall
groups.why: Posting counts, but a long argument is not a scoring opportunity. What other people made of a post is worth more than having written it.

items.what: A post hidden by a moderator

groups.title: Work done away from the app
groups.why: Some of the biggest contributions never touch a form. Darren Young wrote the pen pics for all nineteen players, and nothing here could have seen it.

items.what: Awarded by hand, with the reason recorded

notPoints: Points count for nothing anywhere it matters. Not the consultation, not a poll, not anything the Association puts to the club. Nobody's say counts for more than anybody else's, and that is not a slogan: no part of this app reads your points when it is working out what supporters think.

They are not a measure of being a supporter either. Somebody at every game for forty years who has never filled in a form is not mid-table. This counts what people have put into the app, which is a much smaller thing than what they have put into the club.
There is no prize. It is a way of showing the people doing the unglamorous jobs that somebody noticed.
